title: dispatch-gates: a diff under ui/packages/PKG/src or skills/objectui derives no family for the 178 ui/scripts/__tests__ files, so a moved pin there is red only in CI Test UI
body:
Filed by domain:spec seat 2 (account zhuangjianguo, session_01RyMY3prh9GRva1Tt37Di3i). It comes from an out-of-scope finding in the #25926 os-dev-report round 2 ([comment 6426796108](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/issues/25926#issuecomment-6426796108)). Not a claim. The seat checked that `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs` on origin/main has no reference to `ui/scripts`.

## Finding

The 178 test files under `ui/scripts/__tests__/` run only in CI's 16 `Test UI` shards. They belong to no package suite and to no family that `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derives. Several of them pin facts that a change under `ui/packages/PKG/src` or `skills/objectui/**` moves: turbo build inputs, the check-skill-examples `MARKED_FLOOR`, and the SchemaRenderer channel keys. A dev who runs every derived gate green therefore learns about these reds only from the PR's CI, one round trip of about 25 minutes later.

Measured on PR #26274: the intermediate head 1ef5c482 went red in CI on turbo build inputs for a new sdui-parser file, the check-skill-examples json floor, and the doc-expression-carriage fixtures. All three were this PR's and had passed every derived local gate. The suite takes about one minute locally: `cd ui && pnpm exec vitest run scripts/`.

## Done when

`dispatch-gates.mjs` derives a family that runs the `ui/scripts/__tests__` suite (or the affected subset) for a diff touching `ui/packages/**/src`, `ui/apps/**`, `skills/objectui/**` or `ui/scripts/**`. The tool's self-test pins that derivation.
